key_insight: ChatGPT responses were broadly consistent with chiropractic guidelines, but college-level readability and variable expert judgments complicate patient education use.
clinical_relevance: AI-generated chiropractic information may support patient education, but readability adaptation and expert review remain important.
method: Developed 30 questions on low back, neck, and chronic musculoskeletal pain using U.S. chiropractic guidelines.
Generated GPT-5.2 responses in isolated sessions and assessed readability.
Five licensed chiropractors independently rated relevance, clarity, completeness, and accuracy on 5-point scales.
evidence_signal: Mean ratings were 4.72 for relevance, 4.76 for clarity, 4.23 for completeness, and 4.00 for accuracy, but inter-rater reliability was poor (ordinal Krippendorff’s α: −0.023 to 0.214).
watch_item: This 30-question expert evaluation did not establish patient comprehension or clinical outcomes.
paper_title: Evaluating ChatGPTs Responses to Chiropractic Patient Questions: A Comparative Study
